episodes.title: Sophia
episodes.summary: Things are looking dire when 20-something Sophia loses her job and gets an eviction notice -- until a thrift store find gives her an idea.

episodes.title: The Hern
episodes.summary: Sophia combs an estate sale for vintage clothes but gets sidelined by a mysterious bikini-area injury and goes to the free clinic.

episodes.title: Thank You, San Francisco
episodes.summary: Sophia still needs a name for her eBay store, so she drags Shane around the city hoping inspiration will strike. But it's not a date.

episodes.title: Ladyshopper99
episodes.summary: When an angry bride-to-be sends back a ''discolored'' dress, Sophia scrambles to fix it in time for the wedding so her seller rating won't get ruined.

episodes.title: Top 8
episodes.summary: Sophia reflects on her friendship with Annie, including an ill-fated trip to Coachella, after they have a fight about her Myspace page.

episodes.title: Five Percent
episodes.summary: Shane and Sophia sleep together -- carefully -- before he goes on tour. When Sophia gets health insurance, she ponders quitting her new job.

episodes.title: Long-Ass Pants
episodes.summary: Nasty Gal is getting serious buzz, but not everyone's a fan ... including the online rival who shows up unannounced at Sophia's apartment.

episodes.title: The Trip
episodes.summary: Sophia, Annie and Dax take a road trip to LA to see Shane. Annie and Dax have a mind-bending experience after a night out.

episodes.title: Motherfuckin' Bar Graphs
episodes.summary: Sophia needs to ask her dad for help, so Dax draws up a business plan to impress him, and Sophia brings Shane along as a buffer.

episodes.title: Vintage Fashion Forum
episodes.summary: Annie asks Sophia for a paying job and doesn't like the answer she gets. The members of the vintage fashion forum lash out at Sophia.

episodes.title: Garbage Person
episodes.summary: At christmastime, a down-and-out Sophia yells at carolers, confronts a nemesis and reconnects with an important face from her past.

episodes.title: I Come Crashing
episodes.summary: Sophia hires an Ivy League grad to build a new Nasty Gal website. When Shane's band records a demo, his relationship with Sophia hits a snag.

episodes.title: The Launch
episodes.summary: Sophia's old friends show up at the Nasty Gal launch party to celebrate. But she struggles to stay focused in the face of a betrayal.
